contract: An original worker calls the same patched ID twice on a fresh run. Both calls choose true and commit exactly one frozen five-field version marker at authored sequence 1, followed by the original activity at sequence 2. Stop after actual activity completion before workflow completion. A separate cold process repeats the same calls and finishes the original run, preserving every checkpoint event, durable relationship and exact typed outcome; no second marker or activity is committed. Embedded uses real queue jobs in separate processes. PHP SDK 2.2.6 and embedded Workflow 2.5.5 are the authoring controls; Python/Rust SDK directions and legacy duplicate-marker compatibility remain separate gates.
